headline: 10-year yield hits highest since January 2025
detail: This is a major headwind for growth and tech stocks, especially leveraged ones like SOXL and SPAL. It suggests inflation worries are resurfacing, which can pressure the Fed and keep rates higher for longer.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL further given this yield pressure. Respect QQQ and SMH stops.
